text: Registry policy: no production flow relied on DomainFactory's process-wide canonicalization (5 tests did). DomainFactory is now stateless: every restore mints an independent owner; equal persistent keys combine via checked DomainAlignment; a composition needing one shared owner threads its own DomainRegistry. Identity fixes: dataset voxel/time domains keyed by the content-addressed persistent GridId (was SampleSpace.hashCode = identityHashCode), ephemeral when the grid has no persistent record; latent radial full grid was size-only keyed -> ephemeral. Facade aliases (package.scala, MapEvidence) deleted; callers name locus4s types. Deferred: Parcellation -> locus4s PartialSurjection and Searchlight -> NeighborhoodSystem are close but not exact matches (coarsen/sameBlocksAs; centers-as-Region vs embedded center domain); their only consumers are surface and mvpa-spatial, which U3/U5/U4 restructure, so they move with those cutovers (eco-u3-consumers / eco-u5-spatial) rather than being churned twice.
